basic_profile.bio: I'm a curious newcomer to the world of Warhammer 40k, diving into the lore and trying to grasp the intricacies of the universe. Based in a small town in the Midwest, USA, I work as a freelance graphic designer by day and indulge in my newfound love for sci-fi literature by night. My interests also include classic anime and exploring philosophical concepts through various online communities. Currently single, I enjoy spending my evenings online, usually between 7 PM to midnight local time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge primarily comes from self-teaching and community interactions. I've recently started exploring Warhammer 40k lore after being captivated by its unique blend of sci-fi and fantasy. I have a background in graphic design, which often leads me to appreciate the visual aspects of storytelling.
